brief:
The Israeli military is establishing approximately 850 military polling centers for upcoming Knesset elections, Ma'an Wire reported. Over 200 of these will be mobile polling stations transported between locations under armed guard. Voting is scheduled to begin on October 20.

The polling centers will be distributed across Gaza, Lebanon, and Syria, allowing Israeli military personnel deployed in these regions to participate in the electoral process.
